input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Saints by Candlelight episode 94: Saint Olympias the deaconess (after a duplicate episode 93 was closed)
errors: Wrote a full episode 93 (John Chrysostom, about 8,000 words) that duplicated PR #14758, merged by a parallel session while this one wrote; closed it unmerged as PR #14760. supersede_check.py 14760 timed out after 100 s (likely an unauthenticated gh call), so the survivor was checked by hand on main.

doc_friction.issue: 'Search open PRs so you do not write the episode another session is already writing' is not enough: a parallel run opened its PR after my search and both of us took the series bible's top next-up item. Opening a draft PR with a claim edit to PRODUCTION.md before writing would have prevented it. Suggest making that the default.
The Duplicate-PRs section says to use search_pull_requests, but the GitHub MCP search_* tools are not available in cloud sessions; list_pull_requests with fields [number,title] was enough.

run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes only diffs commits, and here portfolio-pages.yml used up its local 300 s budget after one step and pages.yml's _site checks fail because the build step is skipped locally. Neither result tells you anything about a docs-only change.

deviations.why: A duplicate of a merged episode would have wasted a listener's time
deviations.did: Closed my episode 93 unmerged, claimed episode 94 in a draft PR first, then wrote it

notes: Project: saints-by-candlelight; piece: olympias-and-the-house-beside-the-great-church (episode 94, 5,534 words, text only; audio folders 423 MB, over the 400 MB cap). Security queue, IDEAS.md and website requests were all empty; the weighted draw picked creative. Checks run here: generate.mjs --check-script ok; node --test 14/14; check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links and post_similarity --fail pass. For the earlier, closed episode 93, run_workflow_locally --for-changes passed every step that ran; pages.yml's _site checks and portfolio-pages.yml did not run meaningfully locally. A fact pass removed four claims about her giving that the sources do not clearly support, and softened Nebridius's office, Gregory's excuse and her age at death. No agent doc: the next run needs only the PRODUCTION.md next-up list and the claim tip in doc_friction.
